symptom: After a renderer reload, a persisted top-level frame selection was present in the UI record but absent from the same-directory boot catalog; the real DesignCanvas passive selection publisher treated that advisory catalog as authoritative, published a null frame, and replaced the selection with the page's first frame.
rule: An advisory boot snapshot cannot publish passive selection or prune an exact-owner persisted selection. Passive canvas publication is allowed only for the current authoritative workspace, directory and page snapshot; explicit user selection remains allowed, and an authoritative missing frame may still be pruned.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/design-workspace/__tests__/design-workspace-boot-selection-readiness.test.ts -t "does not prune a newer selected copy"
